title: pH-responsive sodium alginate/CMCS/CMCNa composite hydrogel beads for sustained delivery of 5-fluorouracil-β-cyclodextrin inclusion complexes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25131-25143
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00194G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yaling Wu, Peipei Xu, Jing Lin, WanJing Li, Qing Lin, Hanhao Lu, Jingbo Chen, Zhenhua Liu, Yudong Lu
A pH-responsive hydrogel bead system with a dual-locking mechanism (pH-triggered matrix disintegration and host–guest complex dissociation) achieves high loading (81.23%) and ultra-low release (<4%) for precise colon-targeted 5-FU delivery.
